Crusoe’s Contracted AI Infrastructure Capacity Approaches 5 Gigawatts Across Data Centers and Cloud

DENVER, June 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Crusoe, the AI factory company, today announced the company has contracted 4.9 gigawatts (GW) of AI infrastructure spanning its data center projects and capacity for Crusoe Cloud, its AI cloud platform.
